methodology: Repositories and source files are pinned to Git tree revisions returned by GitHub.
SDK request builders are counted from explicit path constructors plus the login helper; aliases do not add routes.
Case-folded matching joins source references only; it is not a claim about server case sensitivity.
The inventory route discrepancy maps to the existing intended operation; its differing path is not added as a confirmed endpoint.
Record fields are extracted from OCaml type declarations; this is not a wire-schema, required-field or full semantic guarantee.
All code was inspected, not executed. No credentials, game sessions or local user data were accessed.
